assignment.canonical_bytes: UTF-8(salt + NUL + cohort + NUL + decimal_seed + NUL + decimal_env_slot + NUL + episode=0)
assignment.complement_pair_missing_rule: dataset publication requires both successful immutable replicates; never impute or retain one side alone
assignment.rank_rule: lexicographic (sha256_digest_bytes, env_slot); first num_envs/2 route in replicate a; ties break by env_slot

claim_boundary.allowed: randomized factual-arm eligible-trigger intent-to-treat effects and held-out deployed-policy event rates
forbidden: hidden contact-state equality inferred from public-feature proximity

blind.acceptance: aggregate frozen_gate success >= fixed_route success + 10; frozen_gate adds zero dropped and zero unsafe_force events versus fixed_route under non-cancelling counts
blind.first_output_rule: first immutable blind output freezes model, normalization, decision rule and thresholds; no tuning or replacement seeds
blind.run_order: cyclically rotate fixed_continue, fixed_route, frozen_gate by seed index

collection_acceptance.pilot_changes_allowed: implementation bug fixes only; any fix increments manifest/version and old pilot artifacts remain archived and excluded

candidate_action_semantics.route: complete checkpoint-native V6 router via sample_actions(training=False)

feature_contract.note: candidate actors consume obs115; exclusion means obs86 is absent as a direct gate feature, not mathematical independence

gate.frozen_action_indirect_dependency: SEARCH and V6 actions consume obs115, so indirect dependence on obs86 is allowed and explicitly not called clearance-independent

preregistration.manifest_sha256_receipt: recorded by every immutable artifact because a file cannot contain its own SHA256
preregistration.partial_or_failed_run_rule: retain every no-clobber numbered failure report; an exception before pair publication leaves canonical outputs free for retry; a crash-created partial canonical pair fails closed for manual audit and a version bump
preregistration.seal_rule: pilot may start only from the annotated seal tag whose sole parent is implementation_commit; current execution bytes must equal that tag for every bound source
preregistration.source_binding: each artifact hashes collector, feature contract, manifest, task, adapter, bridge, FlashSAC tree, robot/tool/retarget assets and checkpoints

training.decision_rule: continue iff success_continue_LCB - success_route_UCB >= 0.05 AND drop_continue_UCB <= drop_route_LCB AND unsafe_continue_UCB <= unsafe_route_LCB; otherwise route
training.ensemble_bound: mean plus_or_minus one population standard deviation across five deterministic members, clipped to [0,1]
training.factual_loss: unweighted binary cross entropy on only the three heads belonging to the assigned arm; missing counterfactual labels have zero mask and are never filled
training.model_selection: no hyperparameter or threshold search; train cohort fits fixed ensemble, development cohort is acceptance audit only
training.normalization: per-feature train-cohort float64 mean/std, std floor 1e-6, frozen in artifact
training.offline_primary_estimand: balanced randomized difference in factual event means among public-gate-triggered episodes
training.offline_secondary_estimands: IPW and doubly robust policy value
training.randomization_inference: cluster bootstrap and permutation by seed_x_env_slot complementary pair; report success, drop and unsafe separately
training.training_group: whole seed and both complementary replicates remain together
training.underpowered_or_nan_rule: fail closed to fixed-route baseline and do not open blind cohort
training.development_acceptance: frozen decision rule must have success delta 95% lower bound >=0, added-drop 95% upper bound <=0, added-unsafe 95% upper bound <=0, and continue rate in [0.02,0.25]

trial_population.assignment_generation: all env slots are assigned before simulation; assignment is not regenerated from trigger or outcome rows
trial_population.continue_treatment: from the first four-frame public trigger through episode end, execute frozen SEARCH every step
trial_population.eligibility_timing: four consecutive public-eligible SEARCH states before any treatment action
trial_population.estimand_population: episodes that reach the once-only public trigger under common pre-treatment SEARCH
trial_population.missing_trigger: report in all-episode ITT summaries but exclude from eligible-trigger gate fitting because neither treatment was activated
trial_population.observation_window: first episode only, from reset through authored terminal or native timeout
trial_population.outcome_authority: reset-before pick_tool_terminal plus true-convex-hull clearance episode maxima
trial_population.route_treatment: from the assigned trigger action through episode end, execute complete checkpoint-native V6 router every step
